# HEPH-IDEMP-409

**Original request still in flight**

| | |
| --- | --- |
| HTTP status | `409` |
| Area | `IDEMP` |
| Problem `type` | `https://hephkit.dev/errors/HEPH-IDEMP-409` |

## What the caller sees

This is the default `detail` sent in the problem+json response, verbatim:

A request with this key is still being processed. Retry after it completes.

## What to do as a developer

Guidance for the engineer who hit this code. It is non-normative: it is never
sent on the wire and does not constrain an implementation. Wire behaviour is
defined only by `spec/heph-spec.md` and the conformance vectors.

A request with the same Idempotency-Key and the same fingerprint is still being processed, and its lease (60 seconds by default) has not expired. This is a retry-later condition, not a failure, so wait and retry with the same key, which replays the stored response once the original completes. If you see it constantly, the client is retrying too fast or the operation outlasts the lease, so shorten the work or lengthen the configured lease. Do not generate a new key to get past it, which would run the operation twice.
